description: Defines a Duration class in the OpenMRS project, representing durations with SNOMED CT codes and providing methods to manipulate and retrieve duration-related data.

classes.name: Duration
classes.description: Represents a duration with associated SNOMED CT codes, providing methods to add durations to dates and retrieve concept codes.

methods.name: addToDate
methods.description: Adds the duration to a given start date, considering the unit of duration and order frequency if applicable.

methods.name: getCode
methods.description: Retrieves the SNOMED CT concept source code for a given Concept object, if mapped accordingly.
